Regenerated docs/docs/guide.md in full from design/00-brief.md, design/10-design.md, design/20-contract.md (incorporating W94's event_response_pending gate), stamped its digest with ./build/ConvertTo-HumanDocumentation.ps1 -StampGuide, then re-ran the gate: "Human-documentation drift check passed across 18 generated engine page(s), compatibility pointers, and the guide." and "Documentation checks passed across 190 Markdown file(s)."

gates.detail: dotnet test src/host/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests.csproj -c Release — "Passed! - Failed: 0, Passed: 12, Skipped: 0, Total: 12, Duration: 687 ms".

gates.name: Build documentation
gates.reason: This step runs inside the published ghcr.io/the-running-dev/docs-template container via /template/scripts/docs-build.ps1, executed by the docs-ci.yml "verify" job's own container: context (mounted paths, working directory, changelog pre-step). The image itself pulls without credentials, but reproducing the job's exact container invocation by hand was not attempted this pass — CLAUDE.md's documented local equivalent is ./docs.ps1 -BuildOnly, which is not installed in this checkout (docs.ps1 is generated by Invoke-SetupDocs, not committed). The corresponding CI check on the PR ("Verify Documentation Build") is where the answer will come from.

gates.name: Build and verify landing page
gates.reason: Same docs-ci.yml "verify" job as "Build documentation", running after it inside the same container with Alpine chromium installed for the real-browser suite. Not attempted for the same reason — no local ./docs.ps1, and hand-reproducing the container job was out of scope for this pass. The CI check on the PR is where the answer will come from.

gates.name: Merge landing page into documentation build
gates.reason: Downstream of "Build documentation" and "Build and verify landing page" in the same job — npm --prefix site run merge overlays the landing page onto that job's own docs build output, which was not produced locally this pass. The CI check on the PR is where the answer will come from.

gates.name: Positive route and probe smoke
gates.reason: host-image.yml builds the platform static host Docker image, starts the container, and curls its routes/probes. Docker is available locally and the base image pulls without credentials, but the build itself needs NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN for a private NuGet feed restore, and the full build+run+curl sequence was not attempted this pass given its cost and its complete independence from this PR's change surface (src/engine/src/kinds/simulation only). The CI check on the PR is where the answer will come from.

gates.name: Negative fixture -- corrupted artifact must fail to start
gates.reason: Same host-image.yml job as "Positive route and probe smoke", building a second image from a deliberately corrupted artifact and asserting it fails to start. Not attempted for the same reason. The CI check on the PR is where the answer will come from.
